description: Free-text search across every public resource family on The Holistic Care (blog articles, mindfulness games, free guided practices, research summaries, glossary terms, and public PanchaVikas resources). Use this as the general entry point when a request doesn't clearly belong to one specific family — e.g. 'Find something about breathing for anxiety' or 'What has THC published about nondual awareness?'. `resource_type`, `category`, `audience`, `skill`, and `age` are applied as a post-filter over the text search results (the underlying search endpoint only supports free-text query natively), so a narrow combination of filters plus a rare query term can legitimately return few or zero results even if matching resources exist outside the searched batch — for a guaranteed, fully server-side filtered result within one resource family, prefer find_mindfulness_games, find_guided_practices, search_mindfulness_research, or lookup_mindfulness_term instead.
name: search_mindfulness_resources
title: Search mindfulness resources
